steps.en: OCMS finds that the registered address differs from the furnished one
steps.id: OCMS mendeteksi alamat terdaftar berbeda dari alamat furnish
steps.why_en: Nothing compares the two addresses, so a difference is never detected.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pembandingan kedua alamat, sehingga perbedaan tidak pernah terdeteksi.

steps.en: The notice is suspended for a while under a set reason
steps.id: Notice ditangguhkan sementara dengan alasan tertentu
steps.why_en: No suspension reason exists for an address difference; the only address-related suspension covers invalid addresses.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada alasan penangguhan untuk beda alamat; penangguhan terkait alamat hanya untuk alamat tidak valid.

steps.en: A work item holds the notice and both addresses
steps.id: Work item berisi notice dan kedua alamat
steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that stores nothing.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang tidak menyimpan apa pun.

steps.en: The work item appears on the OIC dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: The staff portal has a menu entry only; no page lists such work items.
steps.why_id: Portal staff hanya punya entri menu; tidak ada halaman yang menampilkan work item itu.

steps.en: The officer chooses which address the reminder goes to
steps.why_en: Staff can pick the letter address in the normal furnish flow, but not as follow-up to a mismatch work item.
steps.why_id: Staff bisa memilih alamat surat di alur furnish biasa, tetapi bukan sebagai tindak lanjut work item beda alamat.
